pattern: Official Vite ThemeProvider context, persisted state, root theme class, useTheme consumer.
adaptations: Dark initial default and dark root tokens.
Only validated dark and light values are supported.
Theme selection remains usable when browser storage is unavailable.
The theme-color meta value follows the selected palette.
components: Existing official shadcn/ui and AI Elements registry components are reused unchanged. Prior registry provenance remains in artifacts/frontend-standard/provenance.
